Y JOB SUMMARY

Provides a high level of property maintenance knowledge. Position has overall responsibility for maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection. Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintenance and energy conservation. Develops and implements strategies that will deliver products and services, which meet or exceed the needs and expectations of guests and employees while maximizing the financial performance. Responsible for maintaining standards and regulatory requirements. Leads the emergency response team for all facility issues.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/Electrical/Plumbing.
OR
• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 4 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/Electrical/Plumbing.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets

• Works with property and regional engineering leadership team to determine how Engineering is performing against budget and highlights areas of concern to leadership.
• Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures.
• Administers service contracts to support property needs.
• Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.
• Coaches and supports engineering leadership team to effectively manage controllable expenses (e.g., wages, heat, light and power, water consumption, tools and equipment, grounds keeping supplies, uniforms, vendors, service agreements, inventory, etc.).
• Manages and controls heat, light and power.
• Develops an engineering operating strategy that is aligned with the property/brand’s business strategy.
• Develops and manages Engineering budget.
• Ensures integration of departmental goals in game plans.
• Oversees execution of long term preventative maintenance and 10 year asset protection plans.
• Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Engineering is performing against budget.
• Addresses potential areas of concern and proposing solutions to owners in a proactive manner.
• Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.
• Supervises construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.

Maintaining Engineering Standards

• Ensures compliance with state, local and federal regulations.
• Maintains property life safety systems (e.g., fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems, and alarm systems).
• Ensures building and equipment licenses, permits and certifications are current.
• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.

Managing Profitability

• Manages areas of operation to budget by reviewing operating statements, budget worksheets and payroll progress reports.
• Monitors and manages the payroll function.
• Manages department's controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
• Participates in the development of department's capital expenditure goals; manages projects as needed.
• Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
• Prepares weekly and period end P&L critiques.
• Understands the impact of department's operation on the overall property financial goals; educates staff on details as appropriate.
• Reviews and manages controllable expenses such as, heat, light, power, water consumption, tools and equipment, grounds keeping supplies, uniforms, vendors, service agreements, etc.

Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
• Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
• Utilizes employee feedback and an “open door” policy to identify and address employee problems or concerns in a timely manner.
• Celebrates successes by publicly recognizing the contributions of team members.
• Resolves guest problems and complaints.
• Brings issues to the attention of Human Resources as necessary.
• Ensures that regular on-going communication takes place throughout the engineering operation to communicate daily operations activities, set expectations and create awareness of business objectives.

jobs.title: Vice President - Restaurant Technology & Operations - Arby’s & SONIC
jobs.description:
Vice President - Restaurant Technology & Operations - Arby's & SONIC
is a senior enterprise leader responsible for the stability, scalability, and performance of technology that enables restaurant and digital operations across a large, geographically distributed organization.

This role leads multiple teams of Directors and Managers and owns the operational execution of in‑restaurant, off‑premise, and enterprise technology platforms, ensuring high availability, consistent performance, and minimal disruption to restaurant operations and franchise partners of the Arby’s and SONIC brands.

The position focuses on translating business and brand strategies into reliable, repeatable operational outcomes through disciplined operating models, ITSM‑aligned processes, vendor governance, and continuous improvement. The VP establishes and executes mid‑ to long‑term operational plans, oversees complex third‑party ecosystems, and serves as the executive escalation point for technology incidents, service performance, and enterprise rollouts. Success is measured through uptime, service levels, cost efficiency, and the ability to support growth, innovation, and change at scale.

As a cross‑functional leader, the role partners closely with Operations, Digital, Finance, and external partners to balance innovation with operational rigor. A core responsibility is building a high‑performance culture that emphasizes accountability, data‑driven decision‑making, and leadership development, ensuring technology operations remain a competitive advantage for a large‑scale enterprise.

Responsibilities

Establishes and implements strategies that have short, mid, and long-term impact on company results
Improves upon entire processes or systems leveraging experiences and in-depth understanding of best practices. Extensively analyzes problems to seek understanding of the underlying issue and root cause of the problem
Establishes and implements tactical and operational plans for the function of the business. Focus is on strategies to achieve business results, which may require substantial development of new processes or standards
Daily interactions with parties within and outside of own job function. May negotiate to influence internal and external parties to accept concepts, practices and approaches of the operational area. Frequently conducts briefings to senior leaders both within and outside the business.
Creates a culture and mindset of ‘starting with yes’ – this leader is responsible for franchisee and internal (non-IT) customer satisfaction and builds relationships and an org culture that works to improve both the effectiveness and the perception of the IT organization.
Develops and coaches direct and indirect team members to drive strong performance, build leadership capability, and strengthen the succession pipeline
Leads enterprise‑level financial strategy and capital governance, optimizing resource allocation to drive sustained growth, operational efficiency, and long‑term financial health.
Defines and champions the organization’s vendor ecosystem strategy, ensuring vendors are leveraged as strategic partners to drive enterprise performance, resilience, and long‑term competitive advantage.
Within their domain, own the strategy, implementation, and operationalization of AI and automation technologies to improve efficiency, decision making, and service reliability.

Education And Experience Qualifications

15+ years of progressive experience in IT management
15+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs with business leaders, product managers, and vendors to deliver complex technology initiatives with measurable results in medium-to-large-sized enterprise environments
10+ years of leadership experience over retail (physical store) technology environments is required; Experience with restaurant technologies (POS, kiosks, digital menu boards/signage, and in-store infrastructure) is highly preferred
4-year Degree in computer science, information systems, or related field; Advanced degree preferred

Required Knowledge, Skills, Or Abilities

Expert knowledge of relevant applications, technical platforms, vendors, and hardware in the restaurant industry
Advanced general management and leadership capabilities with proven success leading business or functional teams
Expert proficiency with Microsoft operating systems and related software, plus familiarity with at least two additional operating systems, such as iOS, Android, or Linux
Expert knowledge with ITSM frameworks such as ITIL; Industry recognized certifications in this area preferred
Expert knowledge in supporting multi-modal and geographical disparate locations
Expert experience in building business and technical requirements
Strong analytical skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret franchisee and end-user business needs and translate them into operational requirements
Strong networking, relationship-building, and influencing abilities
Ability to clearly and concisely communicate to all levels of the organization, including written and verbal communications
Confident presentation skills in front of large groups of people both in-person and over video conference 
Excellent problem-solving ability
Exceptional organization, communication skills, and attention to detail
Ability to meet deadlines and make sound decisions based on data and stakeholder feedback
Ability to work cross-functionally within a highly matrixed organization
Expert in Microsoft Office Suite, including but not limited to Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word
Strong knowledge in the practical application of AI and other modern technology tools
Intimate understanding of technical specification documentation, integration best practices and services-based architecture

This position is based in our Atlanta Support Center, with an expected on-site presence of 80%.

Inspire is a multi-brand restaurant company whose portfolio includes more than 33,000 Arby’s, Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and SONIC restaurants worldwide.

We’re made up of some of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, but we’re much more than just a restaurant company. We’re a team of hundreds of thousands who individually and collectively are changing the way people eat, drink, and gather around the table. We know that food is much more than a staple—it’s an experience. At Inspire, that’s our purpose: to ignite and nourish flavorful experiences.

jobs.title: Head of Restaurant Technology
jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

The Head of Restaurant Technology is responsible for the end-to-end ownership of all technology systems, connected devices, and digital infrastructure across Concessions International's restaurant footprint. Reporting directly to the CITO, this leader will define and execute a forward-looking restaurant technology strategy that elevates guest experience, enables operational efficiency, and supports the company's growth across airports and hospitality venues.

This role is fundamentally about guest experience whereby using technology as a lever to make every dining moment faster, smarter, and more memorable. Whether a traveler has 10 minutes before boarding or an hour to spare, this leader will ensure the technology powering that experience is seamless, reliable, and always improving. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves to troubleshoot a POS outage or triaging degraded network connectivity at a unit.

Technology Strategy & Innovation

▪ Define and own the multi-year restaurant technology roadmap aligned to CI's operational and revenue growth goals

▪ Champion a culture of innovation, continuously scanning the food & beverage, hospitality and retail tech landscape for ideas that meaningfully improve the dining experience

▪ Serve as technology advisor to operations leadership for all restaurant and concessions locations

▪ Identify and pilot emerging technologies such as AI-driven ordering, personalization engines, IoT kitchen monitoring, predictive inventory, and contactless payment that deliver competitive advantage in the airport dining environment

▪ Translate guest experience goals into technology requirements: faster ordering, reduced wait times, smarter upsell, and frictionless payment

▪ Build an innovation pipeline with clear evaluation criteria: guest impact, operational feasibility, and ROI

Guest Experience & Dining Innovation

▪ Own the guest-facing technology experience across all CI locations from digital menu boards and self-service kiosks to mobile ordering and integrations

▪ Use guest feedback, transaction data, and operational analytics to continuously improve the technology experience and identify friction points

▪ Drive adoption of technology that increases average check, improves throughput, and creates memorable dining moments

▪ Lead planning, deployment, and rollout of all restaurant-facing technology systems, POS, KDS, digital menu boards, self-service kiosks, payment processing, and other platforms

▪ Own the full lifecycle of connected devices across all locations from procurement and provisioning to decommission

▪ Establish repeatable implementation playbooks and standards for new location openings and remodels

▪ Ensure all deployments meet security, compliance, and network standards in coordination with the broader IT team

▪ Drive integration between restaurant systems and enterprise platforms (ERP, workforce management, finance)

Operations & Support

▪ Own the technology support model for all restaurant locations in partnership with MSP’s and IT Operations team

▪ Build and lead a high-performing restaurant technology team including engineers, support analysts, and project coordinators

▪ Establish monitoring and alerting practices to proactively detect and resolve system issues before they impact operations

▪ Partner with operations leadership to define technology-related KPIs (uptime, transaction speed, device availability)

▪ Drive a continuous improvement culture regularly soliciting feedback from operations leaders and translating it into system improvements

Vendor & Partner Management

▪ Own all vendor relationships for restaurant technology, POS providers, hardware OEMs, payment processors, and integration partners

▪ Lead contract negotiations, renewal cycles, and SLA governance for all restaurant technology vendors

▪ Manage vendor performance scorecards and escalate underperformance proactively

▪
Evaluate and onboard new technology partners that align with CI's operational direction

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, with at least 3 years in restaurant, food & beverage, hospitality, or retail technology
Demonstrated ownership of POS platforms at scale (Oracle MICROS, Toast, NCR Aloha, PAX, or equivalent)
Experience managing technology across 20+ locations in a multi-site or franchise environment
Proven track record of end-to-end technology delivery: strategy through implementation through support
Strong vendor management experience including contract negotiation and SLA governance
Experience leading cross-functional teams and building technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in airport, travel retail, or high-throughput food service environments
Familiarity with concessions, quick service restaurant (QSR), or fast casual technology models
Exposure to AI-powered ordering, predictive inventory, or self-service kiosk deployments

Technical Competencies

POS & Kitchen Systems: POS platforms, KDS, order management, digital menu boards
Payments & Compliance: EMV, NFC/contactless, PCI-DSS, payment gateway integrations
Connected Devices & IoT: Network-connected device management, MDM/RMM platforms, IoT sensors
Networking: Retail/hospitality-grade LAN/WAN, wireless infrastructure, SD-WAN
Integrations: API-based integration between restaurant and enterprise systems (ERP, labor, loyalty)
Data & Analytics: Operational dashboards, transaction analytics, reporting infrastructure

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, UAS Development
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About The Role

As the Director of Engineering for UAS Development at Harmattan AI, you will build and lead an engineering organisation with various engineering modules from the ground up.

You will own the full technical chain, take the system through qualification and into series production, and build a supplier base and engineering ecosystem that sustains it.

Responsibilities

Organisation Building: Stand up the engineering group including hiring key engineering roles.
Project Management: Act as a project manager handling the delivery of key milestones.
Technical Ownership: Own the full technical chain across airframe, propulsion, avionics, launcher and ground segment, through to flight test and trials.
People Management & Mentorship: Manage managers while staying close to the engineering — run regular design reviews across multiple disciplines.
Supplier Ecosystem: Develop a supplier base.

Candidate Requirements

Educational Background: An MSc in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical or a strongly related engineering field. A track record of building organisations will outweigh the degree.
Proven Leadership: An engineer who moved into management and then into managing managers.
Experience: 10+ years, with at least 4 in engineering management. You have stood up or materially scaled an engineering site — including hiring at pace.
Track Record: You have taken a hardware system through qualification and into series production. Background in UAV, autonomous systems or advanced robotics.
Technical Engagement: While this is a leadership role, you remain credible across every discipline in the group without claiming depth in any, and you take written positions on the cross-module questions no one else will close.
Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of building autonomous defence systems

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering, UAS Development
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About The Role

As the Director of Engineering for UAS Development at Harmattan AI, you will build and lead an engineering organisation with various engineering modules from the ground up.

You will own the full technical chain, take the system through qualification and into series production, and build a supplier base and engineering ecosystem that sustains it.

Responsibilities

Organisation Building: Stand up the engineering group including hiring key engineering roles.
Project Management: Act as a project manager handling the delivery of key milestones.
Technical Ownership: Own the full technical chain across airframe, propulsion, avionics, launcher and ground segment, through to flight test and trials.
People Management & Mentorship: Manage managers while staying close to the engineering — run regular design reviews across multiple disciplines.
Supplier Ecosystem: Develop a supplier base.

Candidate Requirements

Educational Background: An MSc in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical or a strongly related engineering field. A track record of building organisations will outweigh the degree.
Proven Leadership: An engineer who moved into management and then into managing managers.
Experience: 10+ years, with at least 4 in engineering management. You have stood up or materially scaled an engineering site — including hiring at pace.
Track Record: You have taken a hardware system through qualification and into series production. Background in UAV, autonomous systems or advanced robotics.
Technical Engagement: While this is a leadership role, you remain credible across every discipline in the group without claiming depth in any, and you take written positions on the cross-module questions no one else will close.
Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of building autonomous defence systems

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
